# Amazon

> > Amazon is the world's largest online retailer offering products, Prime membership benefits, digital services, and financial products including Amazon Visa, Store Card, and Secured Card.

Amazon.com serves as a comprehensive e-commerce platform where customers can shop millions of products, manage their accounts and orders, access Prime membership benefits including streaming and fast shipping, and utilize Amazon's suite of payment cards and business services. The site integrates retail shopping with digital entertainment, cloud services, and seller programs.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- Prime membership
- Amazon Visa
- Amazon Store Card
- Amazon Secured Card
- Amazon Business Card
- Amazon eGift Card
- Amazon Devices
- Amazon Hub
- Amazon Family
- Account management
- Order tracking
- Payment settings
- Bestsellers

## Core Shopping & Homepage

- [Amazon.com. Spend less. Smile more.](https://www.amazon.com/): Main homepage featuring luxury jewelry brands and Prime shopping benefits
- [Amazon.com: Homepage](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Homepage/page/1C97BE5A-7354-49E3-828D-1A49B8513E5E): Main homepage with Prime, payment products, and seller program links
- [Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/s?rh=n:2235625011): Product search results page featuring gift cards, books, and bestsellers
- [Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/stores/USA/node/17376892011): USA store featuring bestsellers, gift cards, and digital products

## Account & Order Management

- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/homepage.html): Account dashboard for orders, Prime membership, payments, and settings

## Prime Membership

- [Amazon.com: Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.com/amazonprime): Prime membership page with benefits, pricing, and signup for streaming

## Home & Lifestyle

- [Amazon.com: Home](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Home/page/C11117E2-47BF-49F6-A82F-5668EB971777): Home goods storefront with furniture, fixtures, and Amazon payment cards
